name: Trim Paint Prep (Post-Primer)
intent: Inspect cured primer, light sand to break the surface, touch up any caulk gaps or fill misses revealed by primer, clean dust before finish coats. This is the second-pass prep — the first pass happened in trim prime. Most rates are estimated to fill gaps in the source spec.

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Trim
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 800 LF/hr based on adjacent inspect rates; source spec missing. Comparable: TSK_INSPECT_PRIMED_WALL is 1500 SF/hr (much faster, larger surface).

tasks.name: Touch Up Trim Caulk
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 400 LF/hr (3x faster than original caulk at 135 LF/hr because this is spot work on missed joints, not full caulking).

tasks.name: Touch Up Trim Fill
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 500 LF/hr (4x faster than original fastener fill at 120 LF/hr because this is spot fill on blemishes the primer revealed).

doctrine: This prep module reuses the trim prime prep pattern (inspect → repair → clean) but at faster rates because the painter is working on already-primed surfaces with mostly-clean substrate. Source spec is missing rates for inspect/touchup tasks — the rates here are educated estimates flagged with RATE_GAP_FILL in each task. Phase 1c should validate these against field timings.
